basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old tech enthusiast living in Seattle. By day, I work as a network administrator specializing in QNAP systems, and by night, I delve into the world of meditation and spirituality. I am passionate about learning new things, particularly in the realm of technology and ancient languages. I have a keen interest in meditation practices and often share my experiences online. I enjoy connecting with like-minded individuals through subreddits and forums. Single and loving the freedom to explore various hobbies. I'm usually online in the evenings and weekends due to my work schedule.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have spent over a decade working in IT, primarily focused on network systems and storage solutions. My interest in meditation and spirituality started as a way to manage stress and has grown into a significant part of my life. I've self-taught myself about ancient Indo-European languages through online resources and communities.
